Lalibela Ethiopian Restaurant

4.7 (78 reviews)

Ethiopian · Open 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Lalibela serves traditional Ethiopian dishes on injera in a small, warmly decorated dining room in Portland. The vegetarian combination platter is the most-ordered dish, with lentils, split peas, collard greens and cabbage arranged around the plate for sharing.

Reviewers consistently mention the friendly service and generous portions. Several note that the kitfo and doro wat are worth ordering alongside the vegetarian platter, and that the spice level can be adjusted on request.
